program.name: Boxing 35
program.subject: Boxing
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of boxing: bouts, then an EMOM or a circuit.
program.about: Boxing for about half an hour. Each day opens with shadowboxing bouts, then an EMOM of punches and conditioning one day and a bodyweight circuit the next. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels bring longer combinations and harder moves.
